titleEs: Maxroll Last Epoch vs Icy Veins Last Epoch — qué hub editorial seguir
titleEn: Maxroll Last Epoch vs Icy Veins Last Epoch — which editorial hub to follow
descriptionEs: Dos hubs editoriales cubriendo LE. Maxroll prioriza depth ARPG-focused; Icy Veins prioriza coverage multi-juego con heritage MMO. Mucho jugador serio usa los dos para cross-validate builds.
descriptionEn: Two editorial hubs covering LE. Maxroll prioritizes ARPG-focused depth; Icy Veins prioritizes multi-game coverage with MMO heritage. Many serious players use both to cross-validate builds.
verdictEs: Maxroll si quieres depth profundo en LE específicamente con cadencia de updates más rápida. Icy Veins si vienes de WoW/D4 y prefieres su layout familiar, o si quieres cross-check editorial con un second take. Maxroll gana en pura depth de LE; Icy Veins gana en multi-game UX consistency.
verdictEn: Maxroll if you want deep LE-specific depth with faster update cadence. Icy Veins if you come from WoW/D4 and prefer its familiar layout, or want an editorial cross-check with a second take. Maxroll wins on pure LE depth; Icy Veins wins on multi-game UX consistency.

useCases.reasonEs: Maxroll dedica team y editorial cadence más fuerte a LE. Sus guides son más extensos y la tier list más curada.
useCases.reasonEn: Maxroll dedicates a stronger team and editorial cadence to LE. Its guides are more extensive and the tier list more curated.

useCases.reasonEs: Icy Veins comparte layout y editorial tone across games. Si ya usas Icy Veins para otros juegos, su sección LE elimina friction de aprender un hub nuevo.
useCases.reasonEn: Icy Veins shares layout and editorial tone across games. If you already use Icy Veins for other games, its LE section removes the friction of learning a new hub.

useCases.reasonEs: Icy Veins funciona perfecto como second opinion editorial. Si Maxroll y Icy Veins dicen lo mismo sobre un build, signal alta confianza.
useCases.reasonEn: Icy Veins works perfectly as an editorial second opinion. If Maxroll and Icy Veins agree on a build, you get a high-confidence signal.

useCases.labelEs: Patch reaction y tier list updates
useCases.labelEn: Patch reaction and tier list updates
useCases.reasonEs: Maxroll team updatea dentro de 24-48h post-patch. Icy Veins típicamente lagea 1-3 días — el foco editorial más amplio diluye velocity LE-specific.
useCases.reasonEn: The Maxroll team updates within 24-48h post-patch. Icy Veins typically lags 1-3 days — broader editorial focus dilutes LE-specific velocity.

useCases.reasonEs: Icy Veins UI se traduce mejor a mobile. Maxroll's prose larga es harder de digerir en pantalla chica.
useCases.reasonEn: Icy Veins UI translates better to mobile. Maxroll's long prose is harder to digest on a small screen.
